Brand Marketing Management

• Translate strategic direction from the Director into tactical briefs that empower our creative and channel teams to deliver breakthrough work. You'll manage brief calendars, coordinate feedback loops, and ensure every brief is crystal-clear on what we're trying to accomplish and why.

• Develop key marketing tools and deliverables, including campaign briefs, launch plans, messaging frameworks, and strategic presentations that inspire teams and secure alignment.

• Serve as a key POC for the creative team on campaign strategy, messaging, and deliverables. You'll be embedded in the development process, translating marketing strategy into actionable creative direction while protecting the integrity of our briefs in coordination with Creative Production & Creative Operations.

• Facilitate cross-functional campaign alignment. You'll lead kickoffs and status meetings with Growth, CRM, Social, Site, Fashion, and Product teams to keep everyone in lockstep and ensure campaigns are synced across channels.

• Serve as a brand custodian. You'll maintain brand integrity across all customer and community touchpoints, ensuring every activation is on-brand, reflects our values, and deepens community trust and belonging.

Customer & Community Programming

• Bring the RTR vision to life through seasonal storytelling, product launches, and key brand moments that deepen customer connection and drive brand relevance.

• Design and own our community and customer engagement strategy. You'll develop tentpole event series and ongoing community programming that deepen customer connection to the brand, from intimate activations to cultural moments.

• Identify opportunities to increase cultural relevance and expand the brand's reach through partnerships, brand positioning, activations, and community-building efforts.

• Execute end-to-end event production and community initiatives. Performance Reporting & Insights

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Iowa. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

• You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Minimum requirements for this role:

• 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role

• Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue

•

All candidates must be located in one of the following states: North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Iowa.

An ideal candidate has:

• Proven track record of consistent quota achievement

• Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes

• Experience with high-volume cold calling

• Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process

• SFDC familiarity

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Billing errors, concession requests, and cancellation or return exceptions currently land with CSMs, CS managers, and several partner teams, each holding part of the picture. As our customer base and billing complexity have grown, these cases take too long, repeat for the same reasons, and pull CSMs away from adoption and renewal work. As the Contract and Billing Resolution Specialist, you will be the single owner of complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts.

You will take a customer's report that something is wrong with their bill, work out what happened across systems and teams, choose the right path to fix it, and see it through, keeping the customer informed. It is part detective, part project manager, part customer advocate. You will also tell the teams who own the underlying systems and processes what keeps breaking.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Customer Success Managers, Sales, Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal. This is a new role, and you will help shape the case record, the root-cause tags, and the monthly read-out that define how Customer Success resolves billing and contract cases at Samsara.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

• You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

• You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

• Own complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts, from the first report to a confirmed fix, and keep the customer informed in plain terms, including accounts that are delinquent or facing suspension.

• Reconstruct the full story behind a billing error across contracts, order forms, segment or ownership changes, reprocessing, and invoicing, including cases with several AE handoffs and no clean record of what was promised.

• Separate a correction of a Samsara error from a concession, a return, a reprocess, and a contract amendment, and choose the path that fixes the customer's billing, not only the immediate complaint.

• Drive Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to execute the fix.

• Evaluate and prepare concession requests: confirm whether Samsara was at fault, size the request against policy and the approval matrix, write a short case summary (what happened, root cause, options considered and ruled out, recommendation, and risk), route it to the right approver, and confirm the credit is applied and the customer told.

• Support cancellation, return, and ETF exceptions: validate eligibility (purchase and renewal dates, trial history, Return ACV, financing partner, documentation), prepare the case for the approving team, act as the Customer Success fallback when the first approver does not respond within the window, and make sure approved outcomes are processed.

• Be the front door for billing, concession, and cancellation requests: log every request in a single case record, including those that arrive via Slack, email, or Gainsight; redirect them to the right path; and coach CSMs and AEs on what a complete request looks like.

• Fix repeat causes: tag the root cause on every case, separate one-offs from systemic failures, and deliver a monthly read-out to the teams that own the systems and processes involved.

• Carry forward the billing improvement work with Support, Finance, and Product, including earlier detection of billing problems that threaten renewals.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles, including Keep a High Bar, Be Intellectually Honest, and Solve Problems Together, as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 4+ years of experience in billing operations, order to cash, revenue operations, deal desk, contracts, or a similar finance and operations role.

• This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.

• Strong investigative skills: you can rebuild a timeline from incomplete or conflicting information across CRM, billing, and contract systems, including when the people involved have left.

• Sound financial judgment about credits, concessions, reprocessing, and refunds, and a clear way of explaining your recommendation.

• Customer-facing communication that stays honest and composed in hard conversations, and written summaries a leader can read once and decide on.

• A record of driving results across teams without authority over them, including working to deadlines in an approval process.

• Familiarity with order forms, amendments, and terms, and how they flow into billing.

• Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete precedent, and rigorous case management so nothing drops across weeks and stakeholders.

• Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Experience handling escalated or high-dollar billing disputes.

• Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or an equivalent ERP, and CPQ tools. We also use Zendesk, Gainsight, and Sweethawk.

• Customer Success, Support, or account management background with customer-facing financial or contract work.

• Experience building or improving billing dispute processes.

• Exposure to subscription or hardware-plus-subscription billing.

• AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.

• Strong bias for action and insistence on high standards

• Additional experience with Go, Terraform, malware analysis, digital forensics, or FedRAMP environments.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. About the role

Samsara is looking for a Senior Escalations Program Manager to own our most complex customer escalations and turn those experiences into durable improvements. Approximately 70% of your time will be spent managing complex customer finance requests, you will coordinate cross-functional resources, lead executive-level communications, and drive rapid, high-quality resolution for high-severity customer issues. The remaining 30% of your time will focus on programs that eliminate root causes, streamline workflows, proactively resolve potential customer billing issues and scale customer-facing processes.

This role is ideal for a structured, customer-centered operator who can bring clarity to complex situations, build alignment across teams, and translate individual escalations into systemic improvements.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: Digitizing large sectors of the global economy requires creative problem-solving, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to customer success.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, support each other, and hold ourselves accountable to high standards.

In this role, you will:

• Own priority customer escalations end to end, including triage, action planning, cross-functional coordination, risk management, and real-time status updates to customers and executive stakeholders.

• Serve as the single-threaded owner for complex escalations, creating structure and accountability across Sales, Finance, Support, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other partner teams.

• Deliver clear post-mortems and executive summaries; track resolution progress, commitments, and follow-up actions through closure.

• Analyze escalation themes and quantify business impact to identify and prioritize opportunities for process, product, and workflow improvement.

• Lead cross-functional programs to improve the customer experience – standardize escalation workflows, service-level expectations, tooling, reporting, and dashboards.

• Coach frontline teams on escalation prevention, de-escalation, customer communication, and effective use of escalation processes.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles—Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team—as we scale globally and across new offices.

Success in this role will be measured by:

• Reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) for high-severity escalations.

• Improved post-escalation CSAT and NPS.

• Increased percentage of systemic issues permanently fixed within 90 days.

• Consistent SLA adherence and audit-ready escalation documentation.

• Clear stakeholder accountability and completion of commitments arising from escalations.

Minimun requirements for the role:

• 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Support Operations, Trust & Safety, incident management, or a related function, including direct ownership of high-severity escalations.

• Demonstrated success leading cross-functional process-improvement programs from problem definition through implementation and adoption.

• Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to use data to make decisions, quantify impact, and prioritize work.

• Strong program and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders in time-sensitive situations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex situations into clear executive-level updates and recommendations.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

• PMP, ITIL, Six Sigma, or a comparable program, incident, or process-management certification.

• Experience working in a SaaS, technology, or other complex customer-operations environment.

• Experience building or improving escalation playbooks, SLAs, operating rhythms, dashboards, or audit-ready documentation.

• Experience coaching customer-facing teams on conflict resolution, de-escalation, and prevention.

About Schoolhouse

Founded by Sal Khan, Schoolhouse is a peer-to-peer learning platform that delivers human connection and develops durable skills through online learning to best prepare students to thrive in the age of AI. So far, we’ve reached 200k+ learners from 180+ countries and we plan to grow to millions.

About the Vision

Our vision is to provide an education safety net to ensure that no talent goes undiscovered and that every student feels empowered in our changing world. We do this by bringing high school students together around learning to create an environment where they can develop and showcase academic mastery and durable skills.

At Schoolhouse, learning is academic, civic, and global. Students join tutoring sessions where peers help them reach academic goals through personalized support. They participate in Dialogues to discuss challenging issues and empathize across divides. Above all, students belong to a global community centered around human connection.

We believe this vision is ambitious, so we need a team that can move quickly in the face of ambiguity. We value sincerity and empathy and believe deeply in the power of human connection. We step in to help each other out, we think big but start small, we uplift each other, and we’re all learners at heart.

Learn more about our vision and our values here:

• Teen Helps 52-Year-Old Man Earn His High School Diploma

• The Power of Peer Tutoring

• Schoolhouse’s Public Roadmap

• What are Schoolhouse's community values?

About the Role

We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers who want to build stuff that’ll have an impact. You’ll join our 5-person engineering team and own full-stack features that hundreds of thousands of learners and tutors use worldwide.

Engineers at Schoolhouse have lots of ownership — you’ll work directly with our designer and other stakeholders to build out new experiments and streamline existing operations. We think the best way for engineers to build a quality product is to be involved early, drive progress, and stay close to our end users.

Scaling free quality interactions between students around the world comes with challenges that live at the intersection of UX, people ops, and technology. We need to both meet learner / tutor needs while ensuring that these interactions stay high quality and safe.

Some examples of what we’ve worked on include:

• Building an AI simulation & coach to help tutors practice for their first tutoring session

• Experimenting with new ways to connect tutors to learners wanting immediate homework help

• Creating a moderation system to automatically recognize and act on safety issues so humans can focus their time on the most important issues

Responsibilities

• Work with users and teammates to define problems, contribute product ideas, and lead work from prototypes / experiments through deployment.

• Break ambiguous work into manageable steps, coordinating contributions when needed

• Write simple, readable code and create / improve patterns that make future work easier.

• Help teammates grow through code reviews and pairing sessions

About You

If this sounds like you, we’d love for you to apply!

• [Senior] You’ve been a full-stack software engineer 3+ years and have a track record of leading full-stack projects from ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.

• [Senior] You can anticipate risks and make decisions that balance tradeoffs between speed, quality, and user experience.

• You have experience with Typescript, Node.js, React, Next.js, and Postgres (or can ramp up quickly).

• You build for users & have a nose for understanding what would help them the most.

• You move quickly while maintaining code quality. Perfect is the enemy of good.

• You fill in the gaps — you ask for help, but still work independently to figure things out. If necessary you can put on another hat if it’ll help users the most.

• You’re available to work in a US timezone.

Bonus points

• You have deep technical experience with our stack Typescript, Node.js, React, Next.js, Postgres, AWS, and GCP.

• You have experience building mobile apps.

• You have experience working in education or on an ed-tech product.

Life at Schoolhouse

• Work with an amazing team. We’ve got folks with backgrounds in education, consulting, astrophysics, startups, and more.

• Fully remote with flexible working hours. Meetings are in US Pacific Time mornings.

• Take real time off. We have unlimited PTO & use it. Folks regularly take time off throughout the year.

• Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. Work-from-home stipend. Professional development budget. Health, dental, vision (for US employees).

• Semesterly retreats and monthly regional meetups

• Make an impact you can see. Check out our community stories page . Watch students help each other learn. See tutors grow into leaders. Your code will help real people learn and grow.

About the Application Process

• We might make some adjustments, but our expected interview process:

• A 30-minute intro screen to learn more about you and understand whether this role is a mutual fit

• A 45-minute screen where you'll read some code and brainstorm / prioritize product ideas

• A 1-hour programming interview where you’ll fix bugs and implement features on a toy repo

• A 1-hour systems design problem where you'll design a data model / api and handle challenges at scale

• A 45-minute culture fit call with non-technical team members

• Reference calls

We’re building an inclusive and equitable platform for learners across the world, and it’s important our core team reflects these principles too. Research shows people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we strongly encourage to you apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.
